messages:
support-ops: FYI customer BrightPay reporting intermittent 504s and huge tail latency on hosted API since ~09:12 UTC. p99 ~15s, gateway 5xx.
sre-olivia: grabbing traces now, can you paste a couple request ids or sample curl?
support-ops: sample ids: aa3f, bb4f, cc5e. They send lots of short requests (chat + embeddings) in bursts.
eng-marco: quick check -- looks like continuous-batching backlog + per-queue depth hitting limit. dequeue_wait spikes and evictions observed. Started ~09:10 after tenant spike.
infra-bot: autoscaler increased nodes 12->14 but per-worker queue depth stayed at 512. Recommend temp bump REQUEST_QUEUE_MAX_DEPTH for tenant and/or drain backlog.
cs-jay: customer is P1, they want ETA on mitigation.
eng-marco: mitigation plan: 1) disable continuous batching for this tenant (route flag) 2) bump per-queue depth to 1024 for the tenant 3) pause automatic retries to let backlog drain. I'll push canary of routing flag.
deploy-bot: canary rule pushed: tenant=brightpay disable_continuous_batching=true. Rollout 10% -> 100% over 3m.
support-ops: customer reports immediate drop in 504s, p95 down to ~1.2s. p99 still ~3s but improving.
sre-olivia: follow-up: seeing a KV-cache warmup pattern — lots of cold KV misses causing long first-token times during the spike. Scheduling warmup job on new nodes.
eng-marco: added repro steps for infra: run loadgen with many short sequences to reproduce continuous-batching backlog. Example: `wrk -t8 -c200 -d60s --script batch.lua https://api.redwood/v1/generate` (batch.lua simulates short chat/embedding mix).
pm-zoe: (note) need permanent changes: adaptive batch timers, tenant-configurable queue depth, and clearer docs for customers running high-concurrency short requests.
logs-bot: attached trace snippet:
```
trace: dequeue_wait_ms=2800 slot_avail=0 queue_depth=512 kvcache_miss=1
stack: batcher.dequeue -> request.timeout -> gateway.504
```
sre-olivia: incident ticket created INC-2026-847, runbook linked https://redwood.internal/runbooks/queue-saturation. Adding follow-up tasks: permanent tuning + capacity recommendations.
cs-jay: notified customer and scheduled 16:00 UTC follow-up.
support-ops: monitoring metrics for 30m, marking thread as monitored. Ping here with regressions. :eyes:
